body.x: NdotLight Co., Ltd. (CEO Jin-young Park), a 3D design software development company, introduced “NdotCAD” through the YouTube channel of Pangyo Techno Valley, a global convergence R&D hub cluster centered on global IT, BT, CT, and NT.
NdotLight is a startup that conducts SaaS business that provides 3D design software and a self-developed 3D modeling engine in the form of a software development kit (SDK).

The 3D modeling engine developed by NdotLight was selected by CB Insights as a leading 3D engine company in the Metaverse industry. It was recognized for its technological prowess and was selected along with Unreal, Unity, and Blender. Their engine is being supplied to Naver and KT.

3D design software ‘NdotCAD’ targets the B2C and B2B markets. There is an increasing trend of teenage creators centered on metaverse content creators and recently, there is also an increasing need for 2D designers to have 3D design skillsets. In line with this, it was developed so that beginners can easily do 3D design. In addition, as the form of collaborative work increases, it also targets companies that want to collaborate on 3D design.

NdotCAD’s 3D engine is provided to metaverse platform developer that wants to provide a 3D user created content (UGC, User Created Contents) production environment, game developers, and e-commerce service providers.

CEO Jin-young Park said, “The 3D design software market has been around for a long time, but it is a field that has had relatively little innovation. Only complicated software targeting professionals dominate the market, so it is difficult.” He explains the background of the development of the product and continues, “Creators who want to create 3D content tend to be younger and with lesser experience than professionals and there were not many software options for them. Also, the program is very heavy and requires a high-end PC. To compensate for this, we created NdotCAD.”

body.cap: Image of 3D design software ‘NdotCAD’ developed by NdotLight | Photo by NdotLight

body.x: He expressed his aspirations and said, “NdotCAD is easy to use and can be used in any working environment regardless of PC specifications. As a web-based program, it also provides a real-time collaboration and communication environment. We decided to supply our 3D engine and 3D asset data to ‘Genieverse,’ a metaverse platform under development by KT, which is for commercialization next year. We plan to use this as a stepping stone to quickly advance into markets overseas.”

Meanwhile, NdotLight has been selected as the ‘2022 Major 3D Engine Leading the Global Metaverse Market’. It has also been recognized for its global technological competitiveness by winning the Innovation Award at CES 2023.
Source: Pangyo Techno Valley Official Newsroom
